title: Figure Launches Hark AI With 97.7 Score Beating GPT 5.4
summary:
The first 100,000 users who sign up for the debut of the Hark AI assistant this week will receive a complimentary paid plan. Figure's new tool will launch on web, iOS, and iPad, combining several AI models to facilitate computer use, scheduled tasks, and widgets. Its Hark Handoff feature recorded a 97.7 score on the Online-Mind2Web web-agent benchmark, surpassing the 92.8 and 84.1 scores of GPT 5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8.

Figure has raised $700M at a $6B valuation to build its proactive AI ecosystem. Founder Brett Adcock stated that the assistant is the best experience he has had and noted that performance will improve with the release of future AI hardware. The rollout includes a waitlist for those who miss the initial cap on free plans.

100,000 free paid plans.

That is how Brett Adcock is launching Hark this week. The founder @adcock_brett announced on X: the first 100,000 sign-ups get the paid plan free.

Not free for a while. A hard cap. That turns a launch announcement into a race, and everyone who misses the cap becomes the next wave of demand.

The product backs the pitch. Hark Handoff scores 97.7 on the Online-Mind2Web web-agent benchmark, ahead of GPT 5.4 at 92.8 and Claude Opus 4.8 at 84.1.

$700M raised at a $6B valuation, and the whole launch is one post with a number in it.

Steal this: if your launch offer has no cap and no deadline, it is not an offer. It is a pricing page.
